about: How a real person talks on the line. Made 5 Oct 2026 for PLAN.md step 1.3 and 1.8. Each case: what the caller says, what was going on, what the line must do. 'today' is filled only where it was run on the code with no model (branch v5-clean, snapshot CURRENT); 'needs a model' means it was not run. Step 1.3 / 1.8 turn these into tests.
